result.scope_note: The claim is about compliance with the HTTP standard as defined in June 2022. The term 'general-purpose servers' and 'worldwide HTTP standard' are understood to refer to the HTTP specification published by the IETF or relevant standards body at that time.

explanation.text: The HTTP standard as of June 2022 is defined in RFC 9110, which refactored HTTP semantics and became Internet Standard 97.
RFC 9110 states that a general-purpose web server must implement at least GET and HEAD methods.
The specification explicitly treats all other HTTP methods, including POST, as optional for general-purpose servers.
